label: halloween12
title_zh: 鸡皮疙瘩令人沮丧的暗示

lines.en: label halloween12:
scene halloweentrio1
A girl stands alone, pressed up against a wall and dressed in significantly less clothing than she’s accustomed to.
lines.zh: 一个女孩独自站着，紧贴着墙壁，身上的衣服比她习惯穿的少得多。

lines.en: Clothing that was meant to impress not only the man she adores but those around her.
lines.zh: 那身衣服不仅是为了取悦她爱慕的那个男人，也是为了取悦周围的人。

lines.en: Not in a cocky way, but in a way that says “I’m comfortable in my own skin.”
lines.zh: 不是趾高气扬的那种，而是在说“我对自己的身体很自在”。

lines.en: As comfortable as one can be, that is.
lines.zh: 当然，是在一个人能有多自在的范围内。

lines.en: Cold air finds its way out of brand new, industrial air conditioners that line the tops of walls in an otherwise ancient building.
lines.zh: 冷气从崭新的工业空调里涌出来，那些空调排布在一栋原本古旧的建筑内壁顶端。

lines.en: That air reaches her legs and causes her to shiver.
lines.zh: 那股冷气拂过她的腿，让她打了个寒颤。

lines.en: She gets goosebumps.
lines.zh: 她起了鸡皮疙瘩。

lines.en: She’s been extremely susceptible to those since she was a little girl.
lines.zh: 从小时候起，她就特别容易起鸡皮疙瘩。

lines.en: Her mother was the same way.
lines.zh: 她母亲也是这样。

lines.en: Her sister, while less susceptible to them, was cursed with a slew of other issues.
lines.zh: 她妹妹虽然没那么容易起，却被一堆别的问题缠上了。

lines.en: The one pressed up against the wall wishes it were possible to trade places.
lines.zh: 那个贴着墙的女孩希望，要是能和妹妹互换就好了。

lines.en: Getting goosebumps always makes her think of that.
lines.zh: 每次起鸡皮疙瘩，她总会想起这件事。

lines.en: But of course, that isn’t something worth telling anyone.
lines.zh: 不过，这当然不值得告诉任何人。

lines.en: It’s not important at all.
lines.zh: 一点也不重要。

lines.en: Nothing’s important, is it?
lines.zh: 什么都没那么重要，不是吗？

lines.en: scene halloweentrio2
A second girl shows up.
lines.zh: 第二个女孩出现了。

lines.en: Her legs are cold as well.
lines.zh: 她的腿也冷。

lines.en: But instead of letting her mind dwell on the depressing implication of goosebumps, she gets caught in thoughts of how fishnet stockings look best on girls with tanned skin.
lines.zh: 但她没有让自己的思绪停留在鸡皮疙瘩那令人沮丧的暗示上，而是陷入了另一个念头——渔网袜配晒黑皮肤的女孩最好看。

lines.en: It’s a thought much less personal than the girl on our right has, but it is a thought nonetheless.
lines.zh: 比起右边那个女孩的想法，这念头要没那么私人，但终究还是个念头。

lines.en: That thought eventually transitions to how that girl must look underneath her costume, and the girl on our left attempts to break free from yet another sad delusion in the only way she knows how.
lines.zh: 那个念头最终转到了“那个女孩在变装服下面会是什么样子”，于是左边这个女孩试着用她唯一知道的方式，挣脱又一场可悲的妄想。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio3
: Did you know, um...Pac-man was originally called Puck-man but...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，嗯……吃豆人原本叫 Puck-man，不过……

lines.en: : They, umm...wound up changing the name because they realized it would be...too easy to vandalize...
lines.zh: : 他们，嗯……最后改了名，因为他们发现那个名字太容易被……涂改了……

lines.en: : Isn’t that from a movie?
lines.zh: : 那不是电影里的吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Hi.
scene halloweentrio4
: Hey.
: Did you come over here because I looked lonely?
lines.zh: : 你过来，是因为我看起来很孤单？

lines.en: : Whaaaaat? Noooo. Of course nooooot.
lines.zh: : 什————么？才、才不是。当——然不是。

lines.en: : I just happened to be in the area and...thought I’d drop by to say...you look really pretty tonight.
lines.zh: : 我只是正好路过，然后……想过来跟你说……你今晚真好看。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio5
: Oh my God, so do you. I’ve been staring at your thighs all night, I’m not even going to lie.
lines.zh: : 天啊，你也是。我盯你的大腿盯了一整晚，我一点都不瞒你。

lines.en: : That’s, umm...
lines.zh: : 那个，嗯……

lines.en: : {i}Do you want to touch them?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你想摸摸吗？{/i}

lines.en: scene halloweentrio6
: Hm? What was that last part? I couldn’t really hear you.
lines.zh: : 嗯？你最后那句是什么？我没太听清。

lines.en: : What? Huh? There was no last part. The conversation ended after you complimented my thighs.
lines.zh: : 什么？哈？没有最后一句啊。你说完夸我大腿，对话就结束了。

lines.en: : I didn’t even respond.
lines.zh: : 我都没回答。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio7
: Rin...relax. You don’t need to act so weird around me.
lines.zh: : Rin……放松点。你不用在我面前这么别扭。

lines.en: : I’m glad you finally came to talk to me. I’ve been wondering when you were going to all night.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你终于过来跟我说话了。我整晚都在想你什么时候会来。

lines.en: : You didn’t...notice me staring at you or anything, did you? Because I totally wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 你该不会……注意到我在看你什么的吧？因为我绝对没有。

lines.en: : You totally were. We kept making eye contact for like, a split second before you'd turn away.
lines.zh: : 你绝对有。我们好几次对上眼，就那么一瞬间，然后你就把头扭开了。

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound like a thing I would do at all.
lines.zh: : 听起来完全不像我会做的事。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio8
: That aside...are you having fun tonight?
lines.zh: : 那个先不说……你今晚玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : I am, yeah...I kind of love Halloween.
lines.zh: : 开心啊……我其实挺喜欢万圣节的。

lines.en: : Yeah, I kinda figured as much with all the skulls you wear and stuff.
lines.zh: : 是啊，看你成天穿骷髅什么的，我也猜到了。

lines.en: : You don’t really...seem to be having a good time, though.
lines.zh: : 倒是……你看上去不太开心的样子。

lines.en: : Could Yumi not make it?
lines.zh: : Yumi没来成吗？

lines.en: : You could have come...sat with us if you wanted.
lines.zh: : 你想的话，可以过来……跟我们一起坐。

lines.en: : It’s just been Futaba and me for the most part.
lines.zh: : 大部分时间就只有我和Futaba。

lines.en: : Molly pops in to say hi every few minutes but then just awkwardly walks away a few seconds later.
lines.zh: : Molly每隔几分钟就冒出来说声嗨，然后几秒钟后尴尬地走开。

lines.en: : Heh~ Thanks for the offer. I’ll keep that in mind for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : 嘿~ 谢了。今晚剩下的时间我会记着的。

lines.en: : Yumi’s actually on the way, though, so I think that might make things a little awkward for Futaba. Poor girl.
lines.zh: : 不过Yumi已经在路上了，所以我觉得那可能会让Futaba有点尴尬。可怜的姑娘。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio9
: Hey, you wouldn’t happen to know...{i}why{/i} Yumi is always that mean to her, would you?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你该不会知道……Yumi{i}为什么{/i}总对她那么刻薄吧？

lines.en: : I tried asking her on the beach and it didn’t really go well.
lines.zh: : 我在海边试着问过她，结果不太顺利。

lines.en: : I really wish I did.
lines.zh: : 我真希望我知道。

lines.en: : Literally the only thing I can think of is that Futaba doesn’t really stand up for herself.
lines.zh: : 我唯一能想到的，就是Futaba不太为自己说话。

lines.en: : But that alone isn’t good enough reason to constantly bully somebody.
lines.zh: : 但光凭这一点，也不足以成为一直霸凌别人的理由。

lines.en: : Not like, there {i}is{/i} a good reason to do that or anything. I just don’t really understand Yumi sometimes.
lines.zh: : 也不是说{i}有{/i}什么正当理由可以那么做。我只是有时候真的不懂Yumi。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio10
: Did you know it’s her birthday tonight?
lines.zh: : 你知道今晚是她生日吗？

lines.en: : Yumi was...born on Halloween? That's so cool.
lines.zh: : Yumi是……万圣节出生的？好酷啊。

lines.en: : That she was. Such a waste that she’s never even dressed up for it.
lines.zh: : 没错。她从来没为这个打扮过，真是浪费。

lines.en: : So she’s coming to the party in her normal clothes? Like Sensei?
lines.zh: : 所以她会穿平时的衣服来派对？像Sensei那样？

lines.en: scene halloweentrio11
: Pretty sure, yeah.
lines.zh: : 应该是吧。

lines.en: : We better be careful or the two of them might bond over their shared interest in always being buzzkills.
lines.zh: : 我们最好小心点，不然那两个人可能会因为“永远在扫兴”这个共同爱好而凑到一起。

lines.en: : Yeah, right. Those two? They have just about as much of a chance as Maya and...literally anyone.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。那两个？他们的概率大概跟Maya和……任何人的概率差不多。

lines.en: : I’ve never really talked to Maya before. Is she really that unapproachable?
lines.zh: : 我从没跟Maya说过话。她真的那么难以接近吗？

lines.en: : She’s not unapproachable, she’s just...Maya.
lines.zh: : 她不是难以接近，她只是……Maya。

lines.en: : It’s hard to explain.
lines.zh: : 很难解释。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio12
A third girl shows up at the party, several hours late, and takes a spot between the two star-crossed lovers.
lines.zh: 第三个女孩出现在派对上，迟到了好几个小时，在那对苦命鸳鸯中间占了个位置。

lines.en: She has no costume, nor intent to don one, but is instead dressed in clothes that her mother used to wear before walking out on her.
lines.zh: 她没有变装服，也不打算穿，身上穿的却是她母亲离家出走前常穿的衣服。

lines.en: But even if the girl in the center can’t seem to get over that small yet significant part of her life, she still needs clothes.
lines.zh: 不过，即便中间这个女孩似乎始终无法释怀生命中那个微小却重要的部分，她还是需要衣服。

lines.en: Because she, too, gets goosebumps easily.
lines.zh: 因为她也很容易起鸡皮疙瘩。

lines.en: : Finally! I was wondering when the Hell you were going to show up.
lines.zh: : 你总算来了！我还在想你到底要什么时候才肯露面。

lines.en: : Also, where are your manners? You totally just stepped between Rin and me while we were in the middle of a conversation.
lines.zh: : 还有，你的礼貌呢？你刚刚直接挤到我和Rin中间，我们正聊到一半呢。

lines.en: : I’m cool with you blowing {i}me{/i} off but at least say hi to her or something.
lines.zh: : 你晾着我{i}我{/i}没意见，但至少跟她打个招呼什么的吧。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio13
: Hey.
: You look nice.
lines.zh: : 你看起来不错。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio14
: U-Umm! Thanks...
lines.zh: : 谢、谢谢……

lines.en: scene halloweentrio15
: You look like a slut.
lines.zh: : 你看起来像个骚货。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio16
: What?
lines.zh: : 干嘛？

lines.en: : Aren’t best friends supposed to like, you know, compliment each other instead of making them feel like trash?
lines.zh: : 好朋友之间不是应该，你知道的，互相夸一夸，而不是让对方觉得自己是垃圾吗？

lines.en: : Are they?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: scene halloweentrio17
: Hah...
: Is Chinami asleep?
lines.zh: : Chinami睡了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Did she remember your birthday at least?
lines.zh: : 她至少记得你生日吧？

lines.en: : She remembered that you told her to remember it.
lines.zh: : 她记得，是因为你提醒过她要记得。

lines.en: : And I see that she didn’t remember to not tell you I told her that.
lines.zh: : 而我看到她没记得不告诉你，是我提醒她的。

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : It’s whatever, though. It’s just a day and she’s just a kid.
lines.zh: : 无所谓啦。不过就是个日子，她也只是个孩子。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio18
: Happy birthday, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 生日快乐，Yumi。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for getting all pissy with you on the beach.
lines.zh: : 海边那次对你发那么大火，我很抱歉。

lines.en: : Thanks. And it’s whatever. I deserved it. I was a bitch that day.
lines.zh: : 谢了。无所谓。那是我活该。那天我就是个婊子。

lines.en: : I mean, I’m a bitch most days, so it’s cool.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我大多数时候都是个婊子，所以没关系。

lines.en: : How old are you now, if you don’t mind me asking?
lines.zh: : 你多大了，如果不介意我问的话？

lines.en: : I’m-
scene halloweentrio19
: Oh, before you answer that question, I was wondering if you saw Sensei on the way in.
lines.zh: : 哦，在你回答之前，我想问你进来的时候有没有看到Sensei。

lines.en: : He’s been gone for a while now and I thought he might be out there.
lines.zh: : 他已经消失好一会儿了，我想他可能在外面。

lines.en: : If you’re worried about where he is, why don’t you just go look for him?
lines.zh: : 你要是担心他在哪儿，为什么不自己去找？

lines.en: : He’s probably fist deep inside of one of the other girls right now.
lines.zh: : 他这会儿大概正把整只拳头塞进哪个女生的身体里呢。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio20
: F-Fist?!
lines.zh: : 拳、拳头？！

lines.en: : Bullshit.
lines.zh: : 放屁。

lines.en: : Think whatever the fuck you want to think.
lines.zh: : 爱信什么信什么，操。

lines.en: : Who else is missing right now? The rich girl? Class president?
lines.zh: : 现在还有谁不在？那个有钱的妞？班长？

lines.en: scene halloweentrio21
: Well...Yeah, Makoto’s been gone for a while, too. But I don’t think they left together, did they?
lines.zh: : 嗯……对，Makoto也消失好一会儿了。但我不觉得他们是一起走的，对吧？

lines.en: : And even if they did, it’s Makoto. She’s probably just making him do...teacher stuff or something.
lines.zh: : 就算是一起走的，那可是Makoto。她大概只是在让他做……老师的事之类的。

lines.en: : The two of them basically set up the entire party, so they probably went to go get some more...drinks or something.
lines.zh: : 派对基本上是他们两个人布置的，所以他们大概是去拿更多……饮料什么的了。

lines.en: : Sure, whatever. Sorry for not telling you exactly what you wanted to hear. Please forgive me.
lines.zh: : 行吧，随便。抱歉没说出你想听的话。请原谅我。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio22
: Whatever. I’ll let it slide since today is your birthday.
lines.zh: : 算了。看在今天是你生日的份上，我放过你。

lines.en: : But no more saying mean things about the people I like.
lines.zh: : 但别再对我喜欢的人说难听的话了。

lines.en: : You fucking like everyone. You’ve gotta at least let me talk shit to somebody.
lines.zh: : 你他妈喜欢所有人。至少让我找个人说几句吧。

lines.en: : I give you permission to talk shit to Chinami.
lines.zh: : 我批准你对Chinami说。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio23
: Wha-
: You know I can’t fucking do that!
lines.zh: : 你知道我不可能那么做的！

lines.en: : That’s exactly why I gave you permission to do it.
lines.zh: : 正因为如此，我才批准你。

lines.en: : I don’t...need your fucking permission for anything!
lines.zh: : 我做任何事都不需要你他妈的批准！

lines.en: : Yes you do or I’ll take your phone away.
lines.zh: : 你需要，不然我就没收你的手机。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio24
: Chinami is...Chika’s little sister, right?
lines.zh: : Chinami是……Chika的妹妹，对吧？

lines.en: : Are you good with kids, Yumi?
lines.zh: : 你擅长对付小孩吗，Yumi？

lines.en: : Not especially. I just hang out at Chika’s place all the time and she’s always there so...we know each other.
lines.zh: : 不算擅长。我只是老待在Chika家，她又总在那儿，所以……我们就认识了。

lines.en: : Yumi’s just being tsundere. She likes Chinami even more than she likes me.
lines.zh: : Yumi只是傲娇罢了。她喜欢Chinami比喜欢我还多。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio25
: I just fuckin’ said it’s only cause I hang out at your place!
lines.zh: : 我他妈刚刚说了，那只是因为我老待在你家！

lines.en: : Just cause I won’t fuckin’ curse at a kid doesn’t mean I’m good with ‘em or like ‘em or anything! Give me a break!
lines.zh: : 我不对小孩子说脏话，不代表我就擅长对付他们、或者喜欢他们什么的！饶了我吧！

lines.en: : I had no idea you had a cute side, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你还有这么可爱的一面，Yumi。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio26
: I don’t! The fuck is up with you two?!
lines.zh: : 我没有！你们两个他妈的怎么回事？！

lines.en: : I didn’t come all the way here just to get fuckin’ teased!
lines.zh: : 我大老远跑来，不是为了让你们他妈的取笑的！

lines.en: : You have any idea how long that walk was?
lines.zh: : 你们知道我走了多久吗？

lines.en: scene halloweentrio27
: Wait, you {i}walked{/i} here? Is that why it took you so long?
lines.zh: : 等等，你{i}走{/i}过来的？所以才花了那么久？

lines.en: : I left you money for the bus. What happened to it?
lines.zh: : 我给你留了坐公交的钱。钱呢？

lines.en: : I used it for something else.
lines.zh: : 我花在别的地方了。

lines.en: : Don’t sweat it. I’m here now and I’ll ride the bus home with you as long as you’re paying.
lines.zh: : 别在意。我现在到了，回家的公交跟你一起坐，只要你付钱。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio28
: Can I...ride back with you guys, too?
lines.zh: : 我能……也跟你们一起回去吗？

lines.en: : I mean, we literally live in the same building, so it would make sense.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我们 literally 住同一栋楼，所以顺理成章。

lines.en: : And Futaba is going to be staying at a friend’s place tonight, so it won’t be awkward or whatever.
lines.zh: : 而且Futaba今晚要去朋友家住，所以不会尴尬什么的。

lines.en: : Do whatever the fuck you want. I don’t care.
lines.zh: : 你他妈爱怎样怎样。我不在乎。

lines.en: : Just put a fuckin’ hoodie or something on so you’re not flashing everybody on the bus.
lines.zh: : 就是穿件帽衫什么的，别在公交车上露给所有人看。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio29
: Same goes for you.
lines.zh: : 你也一样。

lines.en: : You mean you {i}don’t{/i} want to be sandwiched between two beautiful, barely-dressed girls like you are right now?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你{i}不想{/i}像现在这样被两个漂亮的、几乎没穿衣服的女孩夹在中间？

lines.en: : No. In fact, this feels really fucking weird for me.
lines.zh: : 不想。说实话，这感觉他妈的怪死了。

lines.en: : And it doesn’t help that you’ve both been staring at me pretty much this entire time.
lines.zh: : 而且你们两个从头到尾都盯着我，一点帮助都没有。

lines.en: : You look so cute in those clothes, though~
lines.zh: : 可你穿那身衣服真好看嘛~

lines.en: scene halloweentrio30
: Agreed. And I’m kind of an expert when it comes to calling girls cute.
lines.zh: : 同意。而且在夸女孩子可爱这件事上，我算个专家。

lines.en: : Even if I have zero experience with both men and women.
lines.zh: : 虽然我对男人和女人都零经验。

lines.en: : The fuck does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 那他妈的到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : It’s probably best for all of us if you don’t look into it.
lines.zh: : 我们都别深究比较好。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio31
: Ugh...fuck it. I’m just gonna go get some food.
lines.zh: : 呃……操。我去拿点吃的。

lines.en: : Noooo don’t leave us, we’ll miss you~
lines.zh: : 不——要——别走嘛，我们会想你的~

lines.en: : I already do miss you! In an extremely platonic way, though. Obviously.
lines.zh: : 我已经在想你了！不过是以极其纯洁的方式。显然。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio32
: Hehe~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...
: You might be a natural when it comes to teasing Yumi. Well done, Rin.
lines.zh: : 你在捉弄Yumi这件事上很有天分啊。干得漂亮，Rin。

lines.en: : You might be a natural at being...beautiful and stuff.
lines.zh: : 你在……漂亮什么的这件事上，大概也很有天分。

lines.en: : Is that your pickup line for tonight?
lines.zh: : 这就是你今晚的搭讪台词？

lines.en: : Depends. Did it work?
lines.zh: : 看情况。奏效了吗？

lines.en: : I’d offer to let you come feel my heartbeat and check but I’m pretty sure you’d rip my costume off.
lines.zh: : 我本想让你来摸摸我的心跳确认一下，但我很确定你会直接把我的衣服撕了。

lines.en: : To be honest, I’d probably pass out the second I smelled your perfume.
lines.zh: : 老实说，我一闻到你的香水味大概就会晕过去。

lines.en: : It’s rosewater, actually.
lines.zh: : 是玫瑰水，其实。

lines.en: : And lemon. You forgot the lemon.
lines.zh: : 还有柠檬。你忘了柠檬。

lines.en: scene halloweentrio33
: Holy crap, how do you know that?
lines.zh: : 我靠，你怎么知道的？

lines.en: : Oh! Umm, my sense of smell is just...really good!
lines.zh: : 哦！嗯，我的嗅觉就是……特别灵敏！

lines.en: : I totally haven’t looked through your bag while you were in the shower or anything!
lines.zh: : 我绝对没有趁你洗澡的时候翻过你的包什么的！

lines.en: scene halloweentrio34
: Oh my God...you’re hilarious.
lines.zh: : 天啊……你太好笑了。

lines.en: : Hahah! Yeah! So funny!
lines.zh: : 哈哈！是啊！太好笑了！

lines.en: : I’m gonna go die now! See you later, Chika!
lines.zh: : 我现在要去死了！回头见，Chika！
